recommendation: Keep this external-repo/out-of-build audit as-is for current core reconciliation. If HL7 wants to repair the old 2015May archived HTML page or anchors, handle that through the archive/static publication process rather than this current FHIR source checkout.
issue_request: FHIR-8156 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core ValueSet correction for DSTU1. It reported that the 2015May DAF/QICore medication-code "link to here" anchor at section 1.23.2.1.2088 was broken, with related URLs under /FHIR/2015May/valueset-daf-medication-codes.html and /FHIR/2015May/DAFMedications.html.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-8156 was found in the current git history. The Jira resolution says the issue was resolved by work on other tasks. Historical source shows the old QICore medication binding existed before later cleanup, while qicore2 guide files were removed in 2018 and the remaining legacy bindings.ini entry was removed in a later root cleanup.
additional_context: The requested target is an archived 2015May/DSTU1 DAF/QICore publication link, not a current build artifact. Current source/fhir.ini has no active DAF, QICore, QICoreMedicationCodes, or daf-medication-codes entries. source/igs.xml retains DAF and QICore only as commented-out IG entries, and exact searches for the obsolete anchor/path find no active source references outside historical release snapshots under tools/history/release2.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The remaining evidence places FHIR-8156 outside the current FHIR build scope; changing current medication value sets or historical release snapshot bundles would not repair a live current-spec problem and would risk editing non-authoritative artifacts.
